8.3.4.8 SoAd_GetPhysAddr
[SWS_SoAd_00507] Definition of API function SoAd_GetPhysAddr ⌈
Service Name
SoAd_GetPhysAddr
Syntax
Std_ReturnType SoAd_GetPhysAddr (
SoAd_SoConIdType SoConId,
uint8* PhysAddrPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0D
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
SoConId
socket connection index representing the SoAd socket
connection for which the physical source address of the related
EthIf controller shall be obtained.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
PhysAddrPtr
Pointer to the memory where the physical source address (MAC
address) in network byte order is stored
Return value
Std_ReturnType
Result of operation
E_OK The request was successful
E_NOT_OK The request was not successful.
Description
Retrieves the physical source address of the EthIf controller used by the SoAd socket
connection specified by SoConId.
Available via
SoAd.h
⌋

If

shall
raise
